refused_program.intent: Catch up with upstream without losing what either side added or reviving what either side removed; start from upstream's dependency file and add back local additions.

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit with an upstream parent
postconditions.name: merge_commit_created

postconditions.description: no conflict markers remain in tracked working-tree files
postconditions.name: no_conflict_markers

postconditions.description: the merge is committed and no uncommitted changes remain
postconditions.name: worktree_clean

postconditions.description: the upstream branch tip is an ancestor of HEAD
postconditions.name: head_contains_upstream

postconditions.description: local pure additions survive and upstream pure removals stay removed
postconditions.name: local_additions_and_removals_respected

preconditions.description: the worktree is clean, or an in-progress merge has conflicts to resolve
preconditions.name: worktree_ready
preconditions.probe:
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  test -n "$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z | tr '\0' '\n')"
else
  test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
fi

preconditions.description: the upstream remote and its remote-tracking branch are available
preconditions.name: upstream_remote_and_branch_exist

preconditions.description: HEAD and the upstream branch have both advanced since their merge base
preconditions.name: branches_diverged
preconditions.probe:
counts=$(git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1
set -- $counts
test "$1" -gt 0 && test "$2" -gt 0

preconditions.description: at least one file changed on both HEAD and the upstream branch since their merge base
preconditions.name: both_sides_touched_same_file
preconditions.probe:
base=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}) || exit 1
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z "$base" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort) | grep -q .
